candidates.snippet:
Mamelodi Sundowns 🇿🇦 defeat Al Ahli Saudi 🇸🇦 to win the 2026 FIFA African-Asian-Pacific Cup.

African teams have won the trophy 3 years in a row.

Pyramids FC 🇦🇪 defeated Al Ahli Saudi 🇸🇦 3-1 to win the trophy in 2025.

Al Ahly 🇪🇬 defeated Al Ain 🇦🇪 3-0 to win the trophy in 2024.
